    V8 LANDOWNERS COALITION’S RESPONSE TO ONCOR AND LCRA TSC'S LIST OF
            INTERVENORS WHO DID NOT FILE DIRECT TESTIMONY OR A
                          STATEMENT OF POSITION

          On May 15, 2026, Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission
Services Corporation filed their first List of Intervenors Who Did Not File Testimony or a
Statement of Position¹, which includes intervenors John & Cheri Warriner, Jeffey Kaspar, Kolt
Bunch, Christina Broad Ramsey, Stephen Broad, Joanna Shackelford, and Joe Johanson.
     -​   John & Cheri Warriner - Motion to Intervene granted by SOAH Order No. 10 (May 6,
          2026)
     -​   Jeffrey Kaspar, Joe Johanson - Motions to Intervene granted by SOAH Order No. 14
          (May 15, 2026)
     -​    John & Cheri Warriner, Jeffey Kaspar, Kolt Bunch, Christina Broad Ramsey, Stephen
          Broad, Joanna Shackelford - Motion to Intervene granted as members of the V8
          Landowners Coalition by SOAH Order No. 14 (May 15, 2026)


          ¹Oncor and LCRATSC's List of Intervenors Who Did Not File Direct Testimony or a Statement of Position ( May 15, 2026)
( List ); see also Letter regarding Corrected List of Intervenors Who Did Not File Testimony or Statement of Position (May 18, 2026)

(notifying the Administrative Law Judges of upcoming corrections to the list)



V8 LANDOWNERS COALITION’S RESPONSE TO ONCOR AND LCRA TSC'S LIST OF INTERVENORS WHO DID NOT FILE
DIRECT TESTIMONY OR A STATEMENT OF POSITION ​                 ​         ​         ​         ​         ​                   ​1 of 3
          John & Cheri Warriner, Jeffrey Kaspar, Kolt Bunch, Christina Broad Ramsey, Stephen
Broad, and Joanna Shackelford are members of and aligned with the V8 Landowners Coalition
as is Joe Johanson² in this proceeding. And the V8 Landowners Coalition filed timely
testimonies for 15 members and a group testimony by the May 13, 2026, filing deadline⁴.
         Therefore, John & Cheri Warriner, Jeffrey Kaspar, Kolt Bunch, Christina Broad Ramsey,
Stephen Broad, Joanna Shackelford, and Joe Johanson (1) should be removed from the list of
intervenors who allegedly did not timely file direct testimony or a statement of position and (2)
should not be subject to dismissal from this proceeding.


         ²V8 Landowners Coalition First Statement of Alignment (May 20, 2026)
         ⁴Direct Testimony of V8 Landowners Coalition and Direct Testimony of members filed on May 13, 2026: W. Trent &
Deanna Lea Barley, AH Broad III (Christina Broad Ramsey and Kolt Bunch), Carol Pilgrim for David Dahlberg Estate (Carol Pilgrim
and Alice Powell), Jordan Moore & Dalkae Investments LP, Michael Gibbs, Mark & Regina Kyzer, Marilyn Lundgren (Marilyn &
Carlton Lundgren), Archie Morris, RA Morris, TK Morris, Suzzette & Matt McBee, Kenneth Nowlin, Joe Don Pace, Donna Phillips,
Sharry Ware
